name: 27012 · Clemmons, NC
findings: ZIP 27012 (Clemmons) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27012 (Clemmons) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
